sections.title: Headline
sections.content: AI-agent infrastructure dominates today's GitHub momentum: security-audit skills, computer-use tooling, coding-agent skills, agent workspaces, and terminal coding tools occupy the leading positions. The strongest secondary signals are open ML infrastructure, document-to-GenAI pipelines, and small-device inference.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Coding-agent ecosystems, computer-use automation, AI data and infrastructure, document processing, edge AI, and open-source specialized products dominate the selected repositories. Languages: JavaScript/TypeScript 4, Python 3, Go 2, Rust 1, HTML 1, and Jupyter Notebook 1.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: The daily chart is unusually concentrated around agent operationalization rather than base models: security verification, reusable skills, sandboxed workspaces, plugins, computer-use fleets, and client management all rank highly.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today's signal is less a new model winning and more the agent stack being productized. Developers are building the surrounding control plane while pushing GenAI into documents, markets, and constrained hardware.
